title: Archive Layout Manifest v1
description: Sidecar manifest written by the archive-importer next to an unpacked archive tree. Authoritative record of what happened during the import: how the archive was identified, which subtrees the layout matcher recognized, and the notification events that were emitted. See spec 03 § 6.2 for field semantics.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers must check this before parsing.

archive_id.description: Content-addressed identifier of the archive: SHA256-prefix + filename-stem (e.g. 'a1b2c3d4-takeout-2026-05'). Stable across re-runs of the same archive.

original_filename.description: Basename of the archive file as received.

moved_to.description: Path the original archive was moved to, relative to the importer's data root (e.g. 'unpacked/<id>/<original-filename>').

sha256.description: SHA256 of the archive's raw bytes, lowercase hex.

size_bytes.description: Size of the archive's raw bytes.

mtime.description: ISO 8601 UTC modification timestamp of the archive file at the time of import.

provider.description: Which provider matched the archive's top-level layout (e.g. 'google-takeout'). Null when no provider was detected; in that case subtrees_recognized and events_emitted will be empty.

matcher_version.description: Version string the importer binary stamps so consumers (or future readers of old manifests) know which matcher set produced this output.

start.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the import started.

end.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the import finished writing the manifest.

subtrees_recognized.description: One entry per matched subtree the provider recognized. Each entry corresponds to one archive-subtree-recognized event emitted to the relay.

media_type.description: Hierarchical archive media type (e.g. 'archive/google-takeout/mail'). Matches the same field on the emitted notification event.

output_path.description: Absolute or root-relative path where the subtree lives on disk after unpack.

item_count.description: Number of items inside the subtree. Null from the importer (counting happens later in format handlers).

byte_size.description: Total bytes of all files within the subtree.

event_id.description: Event ID of the archive-subtree-recognized event that was emitted for this subtree. Reused on re-runs (deterministic).

subtrees_unrecognized.description: One entry per top-level subtree the provider did NOT recognize. Records that the importer saw it so consumers / future-us can spot gaps in the matcher catalog.

path.description: Path to the unrecognized subtree, relative to the unpack root (e.g. 'Takeout/SomeNewService').

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the importer first observed this subtree.

byte_size.description: Total bytes of files within the unrecognized subtree.

emitted_event.description: True if the importer ran with --include-unrecognized AND successfully emitted an archive/<provider>/unrecognized-subtree event for it.

events_emitted.description: Complete record of POSTs the importer made to the notification relay. Used on re-run to reuse event IDs without re-deriving.
